about: Clarington is a municipality in Durham Region, east of Oshawa on Lake Ontario. Bowmanville is the main urban centre, with Courtice, Newcastle, and Orono spread along the lakeshore and inland rural lots. The municipality mixes commuting suburbs, farms, a nuclear generating station, and motorsport. About 101,000 people live in Clarington.
